Docs.summary: An event that is raised when validation is requested. Validator components subscribe to this event to perform validation.
Docs.remarks: Handlers run synchronously in subscription order. A validator that performs asynchronous work keeps its handler synchronous and registers an async validator via , for example (sender, args) => args.AddAsyncValidator(token => ValidateAsyncCore(token)). invokes every registered validator and awaits the resulting tasks; throws if a handler registers asynchronous work. Do not use an async void handler: its work is not awaited and is silently skipped.

Docs.param: Cancels this validation pass; it is passed to each registered validator. If cancelled (including already-cancelled on entry) this method throws once the registered tasks settle, and the previous faulted state is preserved.

Docs.remarks: Pending field-level validations are superseded. While tasks are in flight the parameterless is true.
